jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) to join our Internal Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche) division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You will support strategy and acquisition / carve-out projects for PwC across EMEA. In doing so, you will identify growth opportunities, conduct market and sector analyses, and contribute to market sizing, competitive benchmarking, portfolio reviews, and commercial due diligences. Advisory - You will support senior team members in translating complex data into strategic recommendations that help shape PwC’s market position, profitability, and return on investment. You will also build your internal and external network across PwC, its advisors, and other professional services firms.  Transformation - You will contribute to deal pipelines and value creation plans in integration and carve-out projects, supporting a smooth transition from strategy to execution. This includes close collaboration with business units, internal functions such as Finance, and internal and external advisors across the deal lifecycle.Your profile- You have completed or are about to complete your studies in Business Administration, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering or Natural Sciences with a business-related focus.- You have gained more than three years of professional experience in Strategy Consulting, Private Equity, Corporate Development or In-house M&A and have worked across different stages of the deal lifecycle.- Experience in portfolio reviews, market assessments, commercial due diligence, transformation initiatives and value creation projects enables you to develop robust analyses and support strategic decision-making in a dynamic environment.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written. The team language is English.- You enjoy working in diverse international teams, navigate complex stakeholder environments with confidence and bring the flexibility to travel occasionally across the EMEA region when projects require it.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and  divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website. At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society.  In our Business Services we cover internal topics such as HR, Marketing, Finance, Middle Office, IT or our internal legal advice. Drive the development of PwC Germany in our various teams and use your expertise to strengthen our position as a potential employer. We offer you an exciting working environment where you can contribute your ideas and skills. ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) to join our Business Services division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – You will be part of the Products & Technology team and will assume technical responsibility for the engagement management processes in the S/4HANA Public Cloud solution, ensuring a solution that is close to standard functions and industry requirements.Guidelines – You will define guidelines, standards, and the solution architecture for EM to ensure that they are in line with our future system landscape. UNSERE MISSIONAt socialbee, we are on a mission to build a more inclusive society by creating fair job opportunities for migrants and refugees. We believe in authentic storytelling, lived diversity, and the power of digital media to drive real impact.We are looking for a creative Junior Social Media & Content Creator to bring our mission to life across all digital channels. In this role, you will plan, produce, and publish engaging content that resonates with our community. Working closely with our marketing and brand team in Munich, you will serve as an authentic on-camera face of socialbee while building meaningful connections with talents, partners, and supporters.DEINE ROLLE BEI UNS• Social media ownership: Manage content creation, posting schedule, and community engagement across LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Reddit.• Content production & visual formats: Concept, film, and edit short-form videos (Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts), image posts, graphics, and newsletters tailored to channel audiences.• Event coverage & on-site stories: Capture real-time moments at team and community events in Munich through live coverage, short interviews, and behind-the-scenes content.• Impact storytelling: Translate authentic stories from program participants, corporate partners, and team members into inspiring digital content formats.• Team & workflow collaboration: Partner with marketing leads and cross-functional teams to translate strategic goals into creative, engaging campaigns.DAS BIST DU• Language skills & on-camera confidence: Strong command of English and German (both languages used daily in content creation and communication) with an authentic, engaging presence on camera. Additional languages are welcome!• Passion for our mission: Deep interest in socialbee's core topics, including diversity, equity & inclusion, integration, and social mobility.• Modern workflow & AI literacy: Curiosity and openness to integrating AI tools and modern content creation software to streamline editing and brainstorm fresh ideas.• Munich location & hybrid mindset: Based in or near Munich for easy collaboration at local events and key team meetups, combined with generous remote work flexibility.UNSER ANGEBOT AN DICH• Impact-driven culture: A supportive, value-led working environment where your creative ideas directly drive social change.• Flexible working model: High work-from-home flexibility coupled with a vibrant team hub in Munich.• Growth & development: Regular feedback and freedom to experiment with new digital formats and AI tools.• Team benefits: Competitive benefits package, regular team events, and an appreciative work environment.How to Apply• Please submit your CV along with a link to your content portfolio or short video introduction (e.g., sample TikTok, Instagram Reel, or short self-introduction video). We value skill, passion, and authenticity over perfect resumes. We look forward to getting to know you!Über unsWe're a non-profit social enterprise from Munich that connects people with a refugee or migration background to jobs that match their skills. With smart tools, learning offers and a lot of heart, we get talents job-ready and help companies build diverse teams. Our big goal: showing that migration drives Germany forward. Our vision: a world where everyone can make it. Sounds like you? Let's create chances together!

Good to know...Hybrid with a flexible office policy · Base in Germany or Switzerland, with regular travel to Berlin · Full-time · Reports to the Head of GrowthSwitzerland is an established market for Pets Deli with room to grow. We want to give it more focus, deepen our presence and accelerate growth, and this role is its owner.You take ownership of Pets Deli in Switzerland: the growth strategy, the performance marketing, new channels, and an online shop, delivery and assortment that fit Swiss customers. This is a strategic role with a hands-on reality, especially at the start: you run the Swiss performance campaigns yourself and add capacity to the team instead of only steering it. You think strategically and then do the work, with a central team behind you: paid social, creative, our Google Ads agency, tech, operations and R&D. You start as an individual contributor and build up local resources as the market needs them.We work hybrid with a flexible office policy. Your base can be in Germany or Switzerland, on the condition that you travel to Berlin regularly.Your tasks• Performance marketing. You own the Swiss performance channels: you steer our Google Ads agency, brief our Creative Strategist and video team on Swiss creatives, and manage the Swiss Meta campaigns hands-on inside our paid-social setup, from testing and scaling ads to the budget.• Growth and targets. New customers, revenue and CLV/CAC for Switzerland. You report on them monthly and decide where the budget goes.• New channels. You test and scale further channels for Switzerland, from influencers and marketplaces to local media, with clear test budgets and decision points.• Shop and delivery. With Tech and Operations: CHF pricing, payment methods, legal texts, customs handling and delivery promises that match the German experience.• Market strategy. A growth plan for Switzerland: what we take from Germany, what we adapt to Swiss customers, pricing, competition and media.• Pricing and assortment. Market input on pricing, and Swiss customer needs translated into product opportunities with R&D.Your ProfileWhat you bring• Deep knowledge of the Swiss market and its customers, gained by living or working there. You know what selling to Swiss consumers from abroad takes.• A background in digital marketing or e-commerce with a solid understanding of performance marketing. You have, for example, run Meta campaigns yourself or steered an agency.• A hands-on generalist who finds the opportunity, turns it into a plan and then executes. A spreadsheet, an ad account and a fulfilment call on the same day are normal for you.• Commercial thinking: you steer on CLV/CAC and contribution, not on clicks.• You get things done through central teams and partners that do not report to you.• German at native or near-native level, Swiss German at least at understanding level, fluent English. French is a plus.What makes you successful in this role• You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach: you enjoy developing plans as much as making them happen.• You are comfortable challenging established approaches and bringing new perspectives to the business.• You balance long-term market building with short-term commercial priorities.• You want significant ownership and work closely with the central team leads to use it.Are we a match?A lot works differently here than in a classic company:• We try things out, decide quickly and correct just as quickly.• You carry real responsibility. And where nobody is in charge, you step in.• Results count, not hours or titles. Decisions are made on facts, not on hierarchy.• We say openly what we think: directly, in every direction and with respect.• Obstacles do not knock us off course, and constantly learning something new is what drives us.If fixed structures, stable priorities or titles matter more to you than moving things forward, you will not be happy with us.Your Chances• Ownership of a market with a clear mandate and direct access to the leadership team.• A central growth, creative and agency setup you can use from day one, and a role that grows with the market.• A hybrid model with a flexible office policy and a base in Germany or Switzerland, plus a Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg with office dogs.• A competitive salary, a personal development budget, internal coaching and regular team events.• 40 % discount on all Pets Deli orders and a €50 monthly benefit allowance.About us Pets Deli is the leading premium pet food D2C brand in Germany. Whereas human nutrition has seen a strong development in the past years when it comes to basics such as transparency, sustainable consumption and overall health contribution, there is still a long way to go in the pet food sector. jobs.description: - The Institute of Active Polymers at Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon is seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher in Mechanobiology & Digital Twins for its activities in the field of stem cell modification and biomaterials at its Teltow site. The position is initially limited until 30 November 2028.Equal opportunity is an integral part of our personnel policy. The full-time position (39 hours per week) can, in principle, also be filled on a part-time basis.Your tasks:Scientific and methodological tasks:- design and perform mechanobiology experiments with primary T cells, B cells and/or other immune cells at engineered biomaterial interfaces- develop, optimize and apply advanced fluorescence and super-resolution microscopy to resolve receptor organization, close-contact formation, cytoskeletal architecture and signalling in living and fixed cells- establish and use biomaterial model systems, including nanostructured surfaces, hydrogels/​​viscoelastic materials and functionalized interfaces with controlled mechanics, topography and ligand presentation- build quantitative image-analysis workflows for large 2D/3D/4D
